T: Pines, bent by the wind off the hills.
M: The hillside. Somewhere under it, the Buried Barracks.
o: The hole back down to the Baron's keep.
j: A regimental cairn. Scratched into the top stone, in soldiers' hands:
"Second Regiment. Held the ford. Held it." "Fourth. We sang the whole way." "Seventh. Tell my wife the garden's hers."
G: A horde checkpoint: sharpened stakes and a barrier of spears. A painted sign: TURN BACK. OR DON'T. WE'RE BORED.

objects.name: Bo Tumble
lines: Hup! Hup! Cartwheel number four thousand and nine!
Can't stop. If I stand still, it feels like the dream. So I don't.

answer: The long one. Everything soft, everything easy, forever.
The king's raiders at the checkpoint can be bought. Or bored into it. Wim loves a good story. Grask loves a good coin.
Because moving is how you know you're awake. Try it. Every day. Just a bit.

objects.name: Grask
lines: Halt. Who goes there. Pay the toll. The toll is everything you have.

answer: King says nobody passes. King also says pay the toll.
Those two things argue in my head.
Never. Wim says standing up, like a horse. Wim's an idiot.

done: {name} presses a few coins into Grask's palm, very discreetly, and taps the side of their nose.
GRASK: …Right. Right. Nobody here. Off you go, nobody.
The barrier of spears swings aside.
cant: GRASK: Toll's a gold crown. You got a gold crown? No? Then no.
(Someone who knows money might manage him.)

objects.name: Wim
lines: Oh good, company. It's been Grask, Grask and more Grask all week.
Did you know the king sleeps standing up? Like a horse? I'm almost sure.

answer: Not allowed. Unless… you've got a story? A good one? Nobody tells me stories.

questions.ask: Are you scared of the king?
answer: Everyone's scared of the king. And chickens. Mostly chickens.

done: {name} tells Wim the one about the goose. It's a very long story. Wim laughs so hard he has to sit down.
WIM: Go on, go on. Grask won't notice. Grask never notices.
The barrier of spears swings aside.
cant: WIM: Tell me a story? No? Aw.
(Someone with a way with people might talk him round.)
